command:
kubectl -n kof delete service kof-ingest-gateway --wait=false
kubectl -n kof delete deployment,configmap kof-ingest-gateway --wait=false
kubectl -n kof delete secret kof-ingest-server
stdout:
service "kof-ingest-gateway" deleted from kof namespace
deployment.apps "kof-ingest-gateway" deleted from kof namespace
configmap "kof-ingest-gateway" deleted from kof namespace
secret "kof-ingest-server" deleted from kof namespace
